package.name: OpesInsure Cameroon Vehicle Power & Fiscal Power Institutional Master
purpose: Separate mechanical engine power from administrative/fiscal power.
Provide canonical units and conversion rules for kW, mechanical hp and metric PS/CV.
Store authoritative Cameroon puissance administrative / CV fiscal without guessing.
Provide workflow-ready fiscal-CV bands used by automobile stamp-duty logic.
Support underwriting, quotation, motor policy issuance, taxation, reporting and vehicle master-data validation.
package.claude_instruction: Use this JSON as the canonical vehicle power/fiscal-power reference. Never derive Cameroon fiscal horsepower (CV fiscal / puissance administrative) from mechanical hp or kW unless an officially verified Cameroon calculation rule is added as an effective-dated formula version. Prefer CIVIC, registration/official vehicle documents, or another approved authoritative source. Technical power conversions may be calculated; fiscal power may not be guessed.

mechanical_horsepower_hp.meaning: Mechanical horsepower (imperial/SAE-style hp equivalent when normalized from kW).

metric_horsepower_ps_cv.meaning: Metric horsepower; a technical power unit, not Cameroon fiscal CV.

fiscal_power_cv.meaning: Administrative/fiscal vehicle rating used by Cameroon administrative/tax workflows.

rules: Preserve source value and source unit separately from normalized value.
Do not repeatedly convert already-normalized values.
Manufacturer-rated kW is preferred as canonical technical power when available.

authoritative_source_priority.description: Cameroon vehicle identification/valuation record containing vehicle identification information including puissance administrative.
Official registration/vehicle administrative document carrying the recognized administrative/fiscal power.
Human-entered value supported by an uploaded authoritative document and approved under maker-checker.

cameroon_fiscal_power.conflict_rule: If two authoritative sources disagree, do not overwrite silently; create a master-data conflict case.

cameroon_automobile_stamp_duty.collection_context: Collected by insurance companies at subscription/payment of motor third-party liability insurance according to applicable tax rules.
cameroon_automobile_stamp_duty.effective_rule_reference: Cameroon General Tax Code, automobile stamp duty provisions

rate_schedules.label_fr: Véhicules de transport en commun de personnes et de marchandises

exemption_handling.rule: Do not infer exemption from vehicle make/model alone. Exemption must come from verified legal/administrative status.
examples_requiring_specific_validation: foreign vehicle under qualifying temporary circulation status

example_algorithm: Read source power value and source unit.
Derive display hp and PS from kW if source values are unavailable.
Resolve fiscal_power_cv only from approved Cameroon administrative source.
Assign fiscal-power band from verified fiscal_power_cv.
Apply tax/insurance workflow rules using fiscal_power_cv, never mechanical hp.

validation_rules.rule: power_kw must be > 0 for powered vehicles when technical power is known.
power_hp derived from kW must use the configured mechanical-hp conversion constant.
power_ps must never be stored in fiscal_power_cv.
fiscal_power_cv must be a positive integer when verified.
A fiscal power value without provenance cannot receive VERIFIED status.
Do not infer fiscal_power_cv from engine displacement, hp, kW, cylinder count or model name.
A change to a verified fiscal power value must retain the previous version and provenance.
Fiscal stamp-duty band must be derived from fiscal_power_cv, not power_hp.
Public/passenger-goods transport stamp-duty schedule requires a verified valid transport licence.

motor_quote.blocking_rule: If a production workflow requires fiscal power for tax or pricing and fiscal_power_cv is unknown, route to verification/manual review rather than inventing a value.

automobile_stamp_duty.output: applicable fiscal band and configured statutory rate

underwriting.note: Underwriting rules are insurer-configurable and must not automatically equate high technical horsepower with a specific fiscal CV.

requirements: maker-checker required for verified fiscal-power changes

transition_rules: SOURCE_ATTACHED -> PENDING_REVIEW requires complete required fields.
VERIFIED value cannot be overwritten; create new version.

acceptance_tests: A 100 kW vehicle normalizes technical power without changing fiscal_power_cv.
Mechanical hp and metric PS are stored/displayed distinctly.
System rejects writing PS/CV DIN into fiscal_power_cv.
Fiscal power cannot become VERIFIED without approved provenance.
CIVIC-sourced fiscal power is stored with source reference and verification date.
A vehicle with fiscal_power_cv=7 maps to CV_02_07.
A vehicle with fiscal_power_cv=8 maps to CV_08_13.
A vehicle with fiscal_power_cv=14 maps to CV_14_20.
A vehicle with fiscal_power_cv=21 maps to CV_GT_20.
Transport-rate schedule cannot apply without required valid transport licence.
Other-vehicle schedule can be selected when transport schedule eligibility is not met.
Changing an effective-dated rate creates a new version instead of modifying historical issued-policy data.
Unknown fiscal power routes quote/issuance to verification when workflow requires it.
Historical policy retains fiscal-power/rate snapshot used at issuance.
